senses.gloss:
Limb,Ⓒs.ⒹaMgaM, avayavaH, (lit. & fig.); gAtraM; ‘over every l(imb)’ pratyaMgaM, sarvAMgIRa a.; ‘l(imb) by l(imb)’ avayavaSaH, gAtre gAtre.
Ⓑ
 2 prAMtaH, kowi f., sImA.
Ⓝ[Limb]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹaMgim, sAvayava; ‘large-l(imbed)’ bfhadavayava, mahAMga (gI f.); ‘slender-l(imbed)’ ta-nvaMga, komala-pelava-aMga.
Ⓝ[Limb]less,Ⓒa.ⒹanaMga, niravayava, aMgahIna.

Lime,Ⓒs.Ⓓ(Tree) jaMbIraH; See Lemon.
Ⓑ
 2 (‘Quick-l(ime)’) cUrRaH-rRaM, karkara; ‘l(ime)-water’ suDA, lepaH (for colouring); ‘l(ime)-stone’ cUrRaKaMqaH, cUrRopala, karkaraM.
Ⓝ[Lim]y,Ⓒa.ⒹcUrRamaya (yI f.), sacUrRa, karkaramaya.
Ⓑ
 2 SyAna, sAMdra, cUrRopama.

Limit,Ⓒs.ⒹavaDiH, maryAdA, sImA, sIman f., paryaMtaH, aMtaH, prAMtaH, paricCeda; parimARaM, iyattA, avasAnaM; velA (of sea); ‘of narrow l(imit) (scope)’ alpavizaya a.; ‘set or fix a l(imit) to’ paricCid 7 P; ‘no (definite) l(imit) can be set to his fame’ tasya yaSa iyattayA paricCettuM nAlaM (R. vi. 77).
Ⓔv. t.ⒹparicCid, pari-mA 2 P, 3 A; iyattayA paricCid, sImAM nirUp 10 or nirDf 10; See Define.
Ⓑ
 2 saM-ni-yam 1 P or c.; saM-hf 1 P, saMkuc 1 P or c., niyaMtr 10, nibaMD 9 P, nigrah 9 P.
Ⓝ[Limit]ation,Ⓒs.ⒹparicCedaH, sImA-maryAdA-nirUpaRaM.
Ⓑ
 2 parimitatA, sAvaDikatA, samaryAdatvaM, sasImatA.
Ⓝ[Limit]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹparicCinna, parimita, mita, samaryAda, sAvaDika; niyata, saM-hfta, alpavizaya, saMkucita, avyApaka, saMbADa; ‘not through the l(imited) nature of (your) merits’ na guRAnAmiyattayA (R. x. 32); ‘l(imited) meaning’ niyatArTaH; ‘l(imited) knowledge’ alpavizayaM jYAnaM; ‘l(imited) monarchy’ niyaMtritaM or saMyataM praButvaM.
Ⓝ[Limit]er,Ⓒs.ⒹparicCedakaH.
Ⓝ[Limit]less,Ⓒa.Ⓓamita, anaMta, asIma, niravaDi.

Limp,Ⓒv. i.ⒹKaMj 1 P, laMg 1 P, Kor-Koq-Kol 1 P.
Ⓔs.ⒹlaMgaH, laMgagati f.
Ⓔa.Ⓓmfdu, SiTila, komala.
Ⓝ[Limp]er,Ⓒs.ⒹKaMjaH, laMga-KaMja-gatiH.
Ⓝ[Limp]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹKaMja, Kora, Kola, Koqa, laMga-gati, vikalagati.
Ⓝ[Limp]ingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹKaMjavat, laMgagatyA.

Limpid,Ⓒa.ⒹsvacCa, prasanna, vimala, svacCatoya, prasannavAri, vimalajala.
Ⓝ[Limpid]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹsvacCatA, vimalatA, prasAdaH.
